named_group_routes.relationship: O’Brien presents Foucault’s history of culture as a model for the new cultural history
named_group_routes.map_label: Foucault’s history of culture as a model for cultural history (O’Brien in Hunt 1989)
named_group_routes.evidence_note: Hunt’s volume opens its “Models for Cultural History” with O’Brien’s chapter (pp. 25–46), whose opening calls Foucault’s writing “an alternative model for writing the history of culture, a model that embodies a fundamental critique of Marxist and Annaliste analysis, of social history itself.” Checked from the JSTOR chapter preview; the chapter body is unread. This records a model the volume proposes, not uniform adoption by cultural historians.
